text: I asked in #grind by mistake on day one. Nobody minded. They just pointed me to #ledger.
Ledger also owns refunds. Same channel, same people. Saves you a second question.
Hi, it's me, the team you're looking for. Say hi when you get here. 👋
The asset tag sticker is on the bottom of the laptop. Yes, you have to flip it over. Everyone does.
Paste the exact error text. 'It doesn't work' costs a round trip from Berlin to Portland and back.
Nova replied to me in 4 minutes. They are fast if you give them the three things.
I nodded along in a meeting for two weeks before I looked up 'roast window'. Don't be me. Ask.
Roast window is a time, not a place. That is the one everyone gets wrong.
We added the glossary because of new hire feedback. Keep telling us which words are confusing.
Your first PR should be boring. Mine fixed one word. The point is learning the flow, not impressing anyone.
One reviewer. Not two. I asked three people once and got three different opinions and zero merges.
Post the PR link in your team channel. Someone always picks it up before lunch.
This norm exists because of me. I got talked over for a month from Mexico City. Now nobody has to.
Type 'hand' early. The host reads the thread in order, so the first hand goes first.
I used it on my second day and the host said 'Kai, go ahead' and I nearly cried. It works.
People say yes. Truly. The scariest DM you send this week will be the best 20 minutes of it.
I book mine on Wednesdays. No meetings that day, so calendars are empty.
Pick me if you want. I still have questions too. We can be confused together.
Asking for help at minute 31 is following the rule. Waiting until minute 90 is the only way to do this wrong.
You will shadow for a month first. Nobody gets paged alone in week one. Breathe.
The runbook link is in the page itself. Do not go looking for it in the wiki at 2am like I did.
This stop scared me most. Read the on call page twice, then it is fine.
Your note goes on the map for the next person. Mine from 2023 is still on stop 1. That is the whole point.
Made it! See you on the other side. Ping me any time, seriously.
